Class HyUInterface

java.lang.Object
au.ellie.hyui.builders.HyUInterface
All Implemented Interfaces:
UIContext
public abstract class HyUInterface extends Object implements UIContext
Base implementation for HyUI pages and HUDs. Handles template processing, element building, and event dispatch.

      public HyUInterface(String uiFile, List<UIElementBuilder<?>> elements, List<BiConsumer<com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.ui.builder.UICommandBuilder, com.hypixel.hytale.server.core.ui.builder.UIEventBuilder>> editCallbacks, String templateHtml, TemplateProcessor templateProcessor, boolean runtimeTemplateUpdatesEnabled, InterfaceBuilder<?> rootElementBuilder)
      Creates a new interface wrapper.
      Parameters:
      uiFile - UI file path (nullable)
      elements - top-level elements to build
      editCallbacks - edit callbacks to apply before building
      templateHtml - optional template HTML
      templateProcessor - template processor for runtime updates
      runtimeTemplateUpdatesEnabled - whether to reprocess templates at runtime
      rootElementBuilder - root builder that owns this interface
